notes: Compatibility is determined by protocol and ABI versions, not by accepting every pre-1.0 release.
Launch requires a signed policy, launch grant, and whole-build manifest from Certael Core.
Production installs use isolated signed multi-game registrations; legacy explicit launch remains development-only.
Protocol v1 health heartbeats and signed revocation frames are supported.
Windows launch drops malformed pseudo-environment entries while preserving drive-current-directory entries.
Launch-bundle validation distinguishes empty messages from oversized messages and identifies the failing component.
Admission failures return a structured health state and public reason before the protected channel closes.
Admission diagnostics correlate Agent PID, game PID, build ID, session ID, and frame length without logging signed payloads.
Runtime status schema v2 correlates launch milestones to a unique launch attempt and ignores stale status files.
Signed local branding, registered-file verification, repair, and offline controls are supported by the native launch splash.
The Agent is optional user-mode evidence and does not make an untrusted client authoritative.
